prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production 2D fantasy game combat sprite sheet, transparent RGBA, 2 by 2 grid of exactly FOUR SEPARATE full-body poses, large square image.
Input 1 is the immutable character design reference. Input 2 is a previous body-only motion sheet, reference for drawing style, same body proportion, framing and intentional blade-free hand.
Draw this SAME adult tall slender armored X-BODY character: polished white armor edged in gold, black mechanical undersuit, cyan crystals and eyes, exact angular crown helmet, white fur collar and white cape with light-blue interior. Same detailed painted 2D game rendering, clean hard armor highlights. Facing screen right in consistent three-quarter combat view.
New animation: a grounded DRAGON SUMMONING sword invocation, first four successive key poses. Top-left: knees flexed slightly in a broad grounded stance, weapon hand drawn back at waist preparing invocation, left open hand gathers power before chest. Top-right: weapon fist moves up to chest height with elbow bending, open left hand reaches forward, shoulders rotate. Bottom-left: weapon arm raises above head, spine straightens, cape lifts behind, left forearm pulled toward chest. Bottom-right: weapon arm fully raised overhead in regal summoning command, opposite open palm directed at enemy to screen right, both feet firmly planted and cape billowing to screen left.
CRITICAL: draw ONLY a SHORT dark grip in the weapon hand, no blade, no guard, no scabbard, no long rod, no spell VFX. The blade will be composited from an original locked raster. Leave free transparent space beyond the hand. The four poses must actually change shoulders elbows torso knees and cape, not copies translated or rotated. Exactly two arms and two legs each, readable fingers wrapping the grip. Same upright physical body size in all cells. Keep the entire crown helmet, cape and both boots inside EACH of four equally sized cells with large transparent gaps. No overlap between cells, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no UI, no ground plane. TRUE transparent background, no painted checkerboard. Preserve character identity and long human armor proportions.
role: Character identity and body-only sheet layout reference; generated body only, never blade

prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production RGBA fantasy game combat sprite sheet: exactly four full-body action poses in a clean 2 by 2 grid. True transparent background, no labels or borders. Input 1 is immutable X-BODY character design and input 2 is the just-created FIRST four frames of a dragon summoning action. Draw the NEXT four frames of this SAME character, matching paint, detailed white/gold armor, cyan cores, angular crown helmet, fur mantle, white cape with blue inside and long human proportions.
Facing screen right, ground-based attack, same camera and body scale. TOP LEFT frame 5: right weapon arm coming DOWN from high overhead, torso rotates into a forceful diagonal command slash, left open hand pulled back, both feet planted. TOP RIGHT frame 6: strong wide low stance in the power-release follow-through, right weapon fist held forward near waist pointing toward screen right, left palm firmly extended alongside, cape curves in a strong back-left sweep. BOTTOM LEFT frame 7: rising back to a poised controlled stance, right weapon hand forward at chest height, elbow slightly bent, left hand relaxes nearer waist; cape begins to settle. BOTTOM RIGHT frame 8: elegant grounded recovery facing right, shoulders relax, right weapon fist low by the hip, left hand lowered, two separate boots on ground, cape settling.
CRITICAL: body-only drawing with a SHORT DARK GRIP in the right hand; DO NOT DRAW ANY BLADE, GUARD, SCABBARD, LONG ROD, MAGIC, DRAGON or GROUND. The exact approved blade will be composited separately. Must change actual torso shoulders elbow knees and cloth, not repeat identical art. Exactly two arms and two legs per character, intact fingers and grip. Generous transparent gutters between the four equally sized cells, NO character crosses the midpoint or cell boundaries, no cropped cape feet or helmet, fit every entire character silhouette comfortably in its cell. No text UI logos checkerboard. Premium sharp painted 2D RPG quality.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: premium hand-painted 2D fantasy game VFX ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, 12 DISTINCT SEQUENTIAL FRAMES in a precisely aligned 4 columns by 3 rows grid, read left-to-right top-to-bottom, large landscape 2048x1536 canvas, real transparent RGBA background.
Subject: manifestation of ONE magnificent eastern celestial dragon made of concentrated turquoise/cyan spirit energy with pearly white armored scales and elegant gold antler horns, long white flame-like whiskers and mane, dark teal shadowed interior details. An adult fierce majestic dragon, NOT cute, NOT a western winged lizard, NOT a flat symbol. A long coiling serpentine body with small clawed forelimbs. Highly readable sculpted DRAGON HEAD, open jaws, sharp fangs, bright cyan eyes, intricate scale highlights. White/gold/cyan palette. This is an ultimate skill summon, designed to loom much larger than a warrior.
Sequential action within each same-sized cell: 1 a thin coiled golden/cyan energy filament tracing an open circular spiral; 2 the filament thickens with scales beginning to resolve; 3 spectral head emerges in upper left of the coil; 4 head and first horn push out, mane bursts backwards; 5 neck arches higher and first foreclaw extends; 6 jaws open and body length coils around behind; 7 full dragon rises in an S-shaped coil, head high looking screen right; 8 mane and long tail whip out, two claws visible; 9 upper body twists forward to screen right; 10 head lowers into a right-facing charge posture; 11 jaws open further and body stretches horizontally into a compact S; 12 full fierce dragon poised to lunge screen right. Maintain the SAME dragon identity and coloring throughout; actual anatomy, silhouette, coils and flame fringes change frame to frame. Not twelve recolored duplicates.
Keep all parts of each dragon or wisp INSIDE its cell with transparent padding, no clipping or touching neighboring cells. No divider lines, background color, checkerboard, ground, UI, text or human. Rich painted detail, bright crisp cores with thin translucent edges, controlled glow, retain dark teal shadow volumes so it reads over a bright battleground. Avoid fog discs and generic lens flare.

Use case: stylized-concept. Use the input image ONLY as the identity and painted rendering reference of the cyan, pearl-white, gold-horned eastern celestial dragon. Create the NEXT animation sheet of this same dragon attacking, not another summon or twelve icons.
Production RGBA game VFX sprite sheet, exactly 12 frames in evenly aligned 4 columns by 3 rows, left-to-right chronological order, large 2048x1536 landscape. Every frame in its own transparent square with 12% EMPTY transparent padding on every edge; do not touch adjacent cells. Actual transparent background, no color, no checkerboard, labels or grid.
First row (frames1-4): the SAME fierce dragon lunges to screen RIGHT, head leads and pearl scale torso streams in an S curve behind, jaws increasingly open; mane swept backwards; claws extend then pull into a high speed strike. The face is large and fully readable, gold branching horns, long white whiskers, teal shadows, glowing cyan eyes.
Second row (frames5-8): dragon curls its long body upward, twists and banks into a devastating DESCENDING diagonal dive to lower right. The head pitches downward, foreclaws reach for impact, tail lashes behind. Each successive frame has genuinely changed head angle, jaw, neck, claws and serpent coil. Same anatomy, no wings, no extra heads.
Third row (frames9-12): powerful downward bite/dive, head contacts the lower-right quadrant at frame9; dragon's pearly and cyan body ruptures into dragon-shaped flowing energy at10; distinct scales, gold embers and curved cyan flame pieces peel away at11; at12 only a long curling dragon-shaped wake dissolves into separated thin luminous ribbons and scale shards. NOT a smoke cloud. End fades by breaking the silhouette apart.
Illustrated AAA 2D Korean action RPG ultimate effect. Preserve highly detailed majestic dragon and confident sharp edges with controlled translucent aura. Keep dark turquoise interior shadow planes, white scale detail and gold accents; avoid white blown-out blobs, fog or huge halos hiding anatomy. No humans, no weapon, no ground plane. Whole dragon fits inside each cell; it will be animated as a huge summon in the game.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production high-end 2D fantasy game AREA-OF-EFFECT ultimate impact sprite sheet. Exactly 12 distinct sequential frames in a clean 4-column 3-row grid, 2048x1536 landscape RGBA with TRUE transparent background. Each cell entirely separate with ample transparent gutter, no grid lines, no numbers or words.
A huge CELESTIAL DRAGON IMPACT erupting from a common fixed ground contact at x50% y70% of EVERY cell. Cyan energy and pearly-white shards with metallic warm gold streaks and dark slate stone debris. It must read as a heavy WIDE ground shockwave, not a round magic icon.
Frames1-2: thin gold-white contact fracture spreads left/right near the floor, upward azure splinters begin. Frames3-4: massive crescent-shaped upward breaking tidal ridge of turquoise energy and jagged pale stone, sharp luminous central spear of impact, clearly rendered rocks arc outward. Frames5-6: broad gold-edged shock front opens into TWO outward-curving dragon-claw-shaped crests with a dark hollow center, heavy chunks lifted forward and outward; this is the strongest destructive peak. Frames7-8: the waves roll outward and fall apart into individual cyan crystal/scale fragments, big slate stones dropping, wispy low dust under it. Frames9-10: most height collapses, ground ring still expanding with separated fragments and long ground grazes. Frames11-12: broken fading wisps and scattered small ember/shards near the ground, dark dust trails taper naturally.
All frames preserve the fixed contact point and coherent direction, genuinely changing structures, clearly drawn material textures and gravity. Wide low ellipse perspective matching a side-view arena floor, no large opaque floor tile or background. Keep the high mass, sharp detail, bright core, dark stone shadow volumes. No dragons/people/weapons/UI/text/checkerboard painted in the image. NOT 12 copies at different opacity. Detailed painted animation, comparable to an ultimate attack in a premium action RPG.
